spans.s:
Aikṣvāka, ‘descendant of ikṣvāku,’ is the patronymic borne by purukutsa in the Śatapatha brāhmaṇa. Another aikṣvāka is vārṣṇi, a teacher mentioned in the Jaiminīya upaniṣad brāhmaṇa. A king hariścandra vaidhasa aikṣvāka is known to the aitareya brāhmaṇa, and Tryaruṇa is an aikṣvāka in the pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa.
